_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for the connect area. Connect and session lifecycle - discovery, SmartLink, connecting, disconnecting, radio selection. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. A key whose text is missing is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. LADDERS: a key may hold three tiers instead of one string - critical, terse and chatty - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. This partition is empty; the extraction tracks fill it. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.
connect.reboot.started: Rebooting the radio. This takes several minutes.
connect.scan.memory.need_a_group: At least one group must be selected.
connect.scan.memory.no_memories: There are no memories to scan.
connect.status.connect_hint: Connect to a radio to see status here.
connect.status.clipboard_title: JJ Flexible Radio Access — Status Snapshot
connect.network.no_radio_explain: No radio is connected. Connect to the radio on your local network to change its address.
connect.network.state_fixed: The radio is set to the fixed address {staticIp}. JJ Flex is talking to it at {reachableAt}.
connect.network.state_automatic: The radio is using an automatic address from the router. JJ Flex is talking to it at {reachableAt}.
connect.network.use_current_name: Fill in the fields using the address the radio is using right now
connect.network.use_current_name_remote: Fill in the fields using the address the radio is using right now. Not available over SmartLink — connect on the radio's own network to use this.
connect.network.mode_fixed_announce: Fixed address. Enter the address, gateway and subnet mask, then apply.
connect.network.filled_in_report: Filled in {ip}, gateway {gateway}, subnet mask {netmask}. Nothing has been sent to the radio yet — choose Apply to radio.
connect.network.filled_in_speak: Filled in {ip}. Choose apply to radio to send it.
connect.network.confirm_fixed_body: JJ Flex will tell the radio to use the fixed address {ip}, gateway {gateway}, subnet mask {netmask}. The radio takes the new address the next time it restarts.
connect.network.confirm_fixed_question: If any of this is wrong, the radio may not come back on the network and will need someone at the radio to fix it. Continue?
connect.network.cancelled_report: Cancelled. Nothing was sent to the radio.
connect.network.fixed_accepted_report: The radio accepted the fixed address {ip}. It takes effect the next time the radio restarts.
connect.network.fixed_accepted_speak: Fixed address accepted. Restart the radio to use it.
connect.network.fixed_rejected_report: The radio rejected the address. It is still using its previous settings.
connect.network.fixed_send_failed_report: The address could not be sent. See the trace file for details.
connect.network.sent_waiting_report: Sent to the radio, waiting for it to answer...
connect.network.already_automatic_report: The radio is already getting its address automatically. Nothing to change.
connect.network.confirm_dhcp_body: JJ Flex will tell the radio to go back to getting its address from the router. The change takes effect the next time the radio restarts.
connect.network.confirm_dhcp_warning_for: The radio's address may change after it restarts, so any port forwarding rule on your router that points at its current address will need updating.
connect.network.dhcp_accepted_report: The radio accepted the change and will get its address from the router after it restarts.
connect.network.dhcp_accepted_speak: Automatic address accepted. Restart the radio to use it.
connect.network.dhcp_rejected_report: The radio rejected the change. It is still using its previous settings.
connect.network.dhcp_send_failed_report: The change could not be sent. See the trace file for details.
connect.scan.caption: Scan
connect.scan.speed_range: The speed must be 1 through 600 tenths of a second.
connect.scan.end_must_exceed_start: The ending frequency must exceed the starting frequency.
connect.scan.increment_range: The increment must be in kHz, 0.01 through 999.99
connect.gps.oscillator_choice_note: The choice below sets which 10 MHz reference the radio disciplines itself to. Automatic is the usual choice — the radio picks the best one it has and falls back on its own if the GPS loses lock.
connect.gps.time_note: With a GPS fix the radio keeps very accurate time and offers it to your network as a time server. It does not get its time from anywhere else, and there is nothing to configure here — point a computer at the radio's address if you want to use it.
connect.gps.reference_locked_gpsdo: Reference locked. The radio is now using the GPS reference.
connect.gps.reference_change_failed: The reference could not be changed.
